items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: I'd go and sit and play the first set for him, and Cobbs wrestling.

ctx.x: Reading drummer, or both. Well, I'll tell you. Well, I'll tell you. Reading drummer, or both. Well, I'll tell you.

Well, he, he wasn't a very, very. I don't know how to explain. He was a good musician. Mm-hmm. He and his brother Johnny. I used to go. Sometimes, when their show was late, I'd go and sit and play the first set for him, and Cobbs wrestling. My brother would play banjo with them, see? Mm-hmm. And, uh, I would run over and I'd have somebody sitting in the, oh, what's his name, when I was playing at the Absinthe House. They had them standing by for me. Because I wanted to play with the Italians, learn how to play…
